text:
morgan: Heads-up team — aiming to publish the release announcement tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Marketing needs: one-line changelog for the hero, canonical docs URL, a 1-sentence bench callout for the blog hero, webinar CTA and time, and inbound lead-routing tags. Can eng confirm canary cadence and any public caveats?

 elliot: Canary plan good from infra. Ramp: 5% @T+5m, 25% @T+30m, 75% @T+2h, 100% @T+6h if metrics stable. Auto-rollback on error_rate > 0.6% for 10m. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/799

 sasha: Docs staging available at https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/release-1.4. Examples updated to show batching: adaptive. Need eng sign-off on the tiny example that demonstrates `request_coalesce=true`. @elliot please sanity-check.

 elliot: Signed off. Note: small payloads may see slightly higher median until KV warm-start finishes — we'll add a short caveat in the docs and blog.

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @elliot at 2024-06-25T17:00:00Z. Monitoring hooks attached: latency_p95, error_rate, token_cost. Auto-rollback enabled.

 harry: Bench blurb candidate: "Adaptive request coalescing reduced p95 by ~16% on chat-mix tests and lowered token cost by ~7%." I'll produce a short hero line: "p95 down ~16%, token cost down ~7%."

 camila: Webinar confirmed Thu 11am ET. CTA copy: "Live launch webinar: demo + Q&A (Thu 11am ET). Register now." I'll add the registration form to the blog.

 morgan: Inbound routing: tag landing forms campaign=jun_release_1_4 and source=blog. HubSpot workflow will route to SDR queue. @sasha confirm webhook endpoint?

 sasha: Webhook validated. Payload includes campaign, utm_medium, email, company. HubSpot -> SFDC mapping ready: https://internal.redwood/hubspot/flows/release-1-4

 elliot: Final changelog sentence for the blog: "Enabled adaptive request coalescing for small-payload traffic, improved KV cache warm-start for faster first-token latency, and rolled out a staged canary with auto-rollback on error spikes."

 harry: Bench hero: "p95 ↓ ~16% · token cost ↓ ~7%". Graph uploaded: https://internal.redwood/assets/releases/1-4/p95-cost.png

 morgan: Docs canonical link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.4 — examples live after final merge.

 camila: I'll drop webinar CTA + registration link into the blog draft and set up the RSVP flow.

 morgan: OK locking announce for 10:00am PT tomorrow unless anyone flags a blocker. Quick checklist: elliot paste the changelog line (done), sasha confirm docs slug (done), harry attach graph (done), camila add CTA (in progress). Thanks all :rocket:
